# `coverage-check.yml`

## Inputs

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Required |
| :--- | :---------- | :--- | :------ | :------: |
| allow_fork_prs | Allow fork PRs to run this workflow (set false for self-hosted runners) | `boolean` | `true` | no |
| artifact_name | Name of the baseline artifact (must match coverage-store.yml) | `string` | `pytest-coverage-baseline` | no |
| coverage_source | Space-separated list of --cov= arguments (e.g. "src/pkg1 src/pkg2") | `string` | n/a | yes |
| fail_on_diff_cover | Fail if diff-cover reports less than 100% coverage on changed lines | `boolean` | `true` | no |
| fail_on_missing_baseline | Fail if no baseline artifact is found on main | `boolean` | `false` | no |
| install_command | Command to install dependencies | `string` | `pip install pytest pytest-cov` | no |
| pre_install_command | Command to run before installing Python dependencies (e.g. sudo apt-get install -y libpq-dev) | `string` | `` | no |
| pytest_args | Extra pytest arguments (no --cov/--cov-report flags) | `string` | `` | no |
| python_version | Python version to use | `string` | `3.x` | no |
| runner_labels | Runner labels as JSON array (e.g., ["self-hosted", "oke"]) | `string` | `["ubuntu-24.04"]` | no |
| working_directory | Directory to run commands in | `string` | `.` | no |



## Outputs

| Name | Description |
| :--- | :---------- |
| baseline_percent | Baseline coverage percentage from main branch |
| coverage_passed | true if coverage did not drop below baseline |
| coverage_percent | Current total coverage percentage |
